in_sanskrit.name: Ashoke
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immortal, Invincible
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashoke एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘as’ meaning ‘immeasurable’ and ‘shoka’ meaning ‘sorrow’. The name Ashoke is bestowed upon a child to represent the idea that even in the face of great sorrow, one remains immortal and invincible.
